svg.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Slingshot — planning mode (black-hole level)
svg.desc: Planning-mode mockup of a black-hole level: a black hole with a tilted accretion disk in the centre, an ice world start, a barren moon and planet X; ship on the start world with the drag arrow at 62 % power, dotted predicted path whipping around the black hole’s lower-right toward planet X, HUD with fuel, Launch and telemetry.
